parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules associated with document CHEMBL1125820. Source data from molecule_dictionary, compound_records, and compound_structures tables. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, and compound_records to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno to include SMILES. Filter docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1125820'. Sort results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order.
